problem_title: How to run a scheduled job every 15 minutes?
problem: Using the salesforce GUI it seams impossible to schedule a job every 15 minutes. Or more than once a day.
explanation: Jobs cannot be scheduled in increments smaller than one hour. Please read the documentation to learn about how you can schedule jobs that run in more complex patterns than the GUI allows. In Apex, you can schedule four jobs to every hour, staggered 15 minutes apart:
